column3: “Your voice” identifies the source of the sound of tumult.
“Zion’s treasure” names the referent of “his treasure.”
“Witnesses” replaces “cities”; the active clauses become passive.
“Their leaves” supplies the object of shaking off.
“Murderous plots” specifies the reference to blood; the Hebrew retains the image of shaking the hands free of a bribe.
“Former” supplies a time description for the terror.
“Pasture” renders a habitation; the feast expression is singular in form.
“Of Zion” identifies the unstated place of residence.
